tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List every capability surface published at the æ:// homebase (myaelmendez.github.io). Returns each surface as {id, name, address, url, category, layer, layer_name, capabilities}. Optionally filter by authority layer (0 public, 1 published, 2 operator, 3 custody) or category.

tools.name: find_capability
tools.description: Discover æ:// capability surfaces by free-text query, matched against name, id, category, url and capability tags. Use to answer 'does the homebase do X?'.

tools.name: resolve_address
tools.description: Resolve a 4-space coordinate x:y:z:æ (x=category, y=item, z=depth, æ=authority) to the capability surface at that address.

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: Return the full æ:// capability manifest: homebase, operator, authority axis, and every capability surface.

tools.name: verify_chain
tools.description: Return the væult tool chain status — the nine links custody→format→gate→authority→contract→dispatch→publish→delivery→adoption.
